rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Comprehensive MCP server for the OpenZiti Management API that enables AI agents to administer zero-trust network overlays through natural language. Provides 80+ tools covering identity and service management, policy configuration, edge router administration, certificate authority operations, enrollment workflows, OIDC authentication, posture checks, and database maintenance. Supports five authentication methods including identity files, username/password, client certificates, external JWT tokens, and OIDC client credentials with interactive browser-based device authorization grant. Built as a single self-contained Go binary with extensive integration testing against live OpenZiti networks.
